item.description: When stocks and bonds fall together, most diversified portfolios discover they weren't diversified at all. Managed futures ETFs are built for exactly those moments. They can go long or short across commodities, currencies, bonds, and equities, aiming to profit from sustained market trends in either direction. That's why they're often called a source of "crisis alpha." Here's how managed futures ETFs work, why investors use them, and the funds that dominate the category.
